[LHYD.2.1.2] The storage adapter selects the stored facts of the named
schema that entered working memory within the requested window, up to the
call's `limit:` ([LHYD.7.2.1]), and returns them to the engine. It selects by
what it can see beside each opaque record — schema, time and count — and by
nothing inside it ([LSTO.2.1]). The adapter hands each record back with the
call's correlation and `retain:` duration, and the engine decodes it, sets
`corr` and asserts it into working memory ([NCBK.9.2]). The call takes no
`filter:` ([LHYD.8.1]); rules filter the hydrated facts as they match them.
